flow.name: get-order-details-tool-flow
flow.doc:name: Tool: get_order_details
flow.doc:description: MCP tool that returns a massive unoptimized order payload for Payload Optimization policy demo

mcp:tool-listener.name: get_order_details
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: get_order_details
mcp:tool-listener.doc:description: Registers get_order_details tool; fires on tools/call for this tool name
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Returns the complete, unfiltered details for an order including: full customer profile (address duplicated 6 ways, name repeated 8 ways), all product specifications, embedded HTML marketing content with inline scripts, base64-encoded product images, internal ERP/CRM/warehouse IDs, null placeholder fields, verbose 8-event audit history, order totals duplicated in 4 separate structures, and unrelated product recommendations. NOTE: This tool intentionally returns a large unoptimized payload (~15 KB) to demonstrate the MuleSoft Payload Optimization policy for LLM token-cost reduction.

mcp:inline-output-schema.mcp:output-schema: { "type": "object", "description": "Unoptimized full order detail payload — customer, items, HTML, base64, repeated keys, nulls, audit log, metadata.", "properties": { "orderId": { "type": "string" }, "status": { "type": "string" }, "customer": { "type": "object" }, "items": { "type": "array" }, "shipping": { "type": "object" }, "shippingDetails": { "type": "object" }, "payment": { "type": "object" }, "totals": { "type": "object" }, "summary": { "type": "object" }, "auditLog": { "type": "array" }, "recommendations": { "type": "array" }, "_metadata": { "type": "object" } }, "required": ["orderId", "status", "customer", "items"] }

mcp:text-tool-response-content.text: #[write(vars.mcpError default {code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: 'An unexpected error occurred retrieving order details.', orderId: (vars.orderId default '')}, 'application/json')]

set-variable.doc:name: Extract orderId
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts and trims orderId from the tool call input payload

set-variable.value: #[{code: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'orderId is required and must not be empty.', orderId: vars.orderId}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Missing orderId Error
set-variable.doc:description: Builds INVALID_INPUT error when orderId is absent

raise-error.doc:name: Raise INVALID_INPUT
raise-error.doc:description: Propagates so mcp:on-error-responses returns the structured error

ee:transform.doc:name: Load and Stamp Bloated Order Detail
ee:transform.doc:description: Reads mock-order-details.json and replaces order identity fields with the caller-supplied orderId

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] get_order_details | orderId=' ++ vars.orderId ++ ' | WARNING: unoptimized payload returned — apply Payload Optimization policy to reduce token cost']
logger.doc:name: Log Unoptimized Response Warning
logger.doc:description: Logs a reminder that this tool returns a bloated payload and the Payload Optimization policy should be applied

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle INVALID_INPUT
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Propagates INVALID_INPUT so mcp:on-error-responses sends the structured error

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] get_order_details | INVALID_INPUT - orderId missing or empty']
logger.doc:name: Log Invalid Input
logger.doc:description: Logs the missing-input warning with correlation ID
